# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Miraculous Honeycomb; Bees from Paradise

---

**11:1** And the man of God said to her: 'Bring the honeycomb to me.' And Aseneth brought it and placed it before him.

**11:2** And the man of God stretched out his right hand and put a piece of the honeycomb on Aseneth's mouth and said: 'Eat.' And she ate.

**11:3** And the man said: 'Behold, now you have eaten the bread of life and drunk the cup of immortality and been anointed with the ointment of incorruption. Behold, from today your flesh blooms like flowers of life from the ground of the Most High, and your bones become strong like the cedars of the paradise of delight of God, and tireless powers will serve you all the days of your life, and your youth will not see old age, and your beauty will not fail for ever.'

**11:4** And Aseneth rejoiced greatly at these words.

**11:5** And the man of God said to her: 'Do you see this honeycomb?' And she said: 'I see it, lord.' And he said: 'This comb is made of the honey of paradise, and the angels of God eat of it, and whoever eats of it will never die.'

**11:6** And the man touched the honeycomb and white bees arose from the cells of the comb, and they were white as snow and their wings were violet and purple and scarlet and of gold, and they were wearing golden crowns on their heads and they had stings like iron.

**11:7** And the bees flew about and fell on Aseneth from her feet to her head, and other great and very large bees were encircling Aseneth and ate of the honeycomb.

**11:8** And the man of God said to the bees: 'Go to your place now.' And immediately all the bees arose and flew away to the heavens.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
